newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan financial shares down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan financial shares down on profit-taking.

text.p: Taiwan's heavily weighted financial shares fell at mid-morning on Monday on profit-taking as investors took heed of the central bank's weekend call for caution at the market's high levels, brokers said.
With 75 minutes left, financial issues had dropped 1.98 percent, while the overall index was down 0.79 percent.
Hua Nan Bank had fallen 3.57 percent or T$5 to T$148.50, and Farmers Bank was down 2.94 percent or T$2.00 at T$66.00. Both were among the session's most heavily traded issues, the brokers said.
